1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 4 m de altura, de ramas largas y extendidas, con vástagos arraigados en el suelo, hojas enteras, elípticas, obtusas y gruesas, flores amarillentas, fruto seco de corteza coriácea, pequeño y casi redondo, y muchas raíces aéreas. Rhizophoraceae, Rhizophora mangle.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 4 m, with long and extended branches, having rooted suckers on the ground, entire, elliptical, obtuse, and thick leaves, yellowish flowers, dry fruit with coriaceous bark, small and almost spherical, and many aerial roots. Rhizophoraceae, Rhizophora mangle.
